name: Housing Assistance Grant
benefit: - A one-time grant of ₹2,00,000/- for the construction/ repair of the house.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 2. The applicant must be either: - A widow or dependent of a soldier martyred in a war or border clash, or - A war-disabled retired soldier. 3. The grant is provided only once in a lifetime for the purpose of building construction or repair.
